column2: In Telegram, search for @BotFather, send /newbot, give it a name (for example Zond Robot) and a username ending in "bot". Save the token it gives you.
The screen shows a face with two blinking eyes, the status line at the top shows battery and distance from the body, the speaker says "Halo, aku Zond. Aku siap.", and the bot sends "Zond menyala".

The robot does not respond when you say its name: check the Serial Monitor. Lines "[dengar] tanpa nama, diabaikan" (no name, ignored) show what it heard; if the name is written very differently, change NAMA_ROBOT to a name that is easier to pronounce clearly. The robot also does not listen while the speaker is making sound, including while music or radio is playing.
Finally, chat: "Zond, maju sedikit lalu lihat ke kiri, ada apa di sana?" (Zond, move forward a little then look left, what is there?)

The brain code cuts your voice into sentences (16 kHz WAV, at most 6 seconds), sends them to the whisper-large-v3-turbo model with Indonesian as the language, and receives the text. By default the robot only records after you press BICARA (on the screen or the web panel), so the Groq quota does not run out.

Change NAMA_ROBOT (default Zond) and NAMA_PEMILIK as you like. Pick a robot name that is short and rarely used in everyday conversation, because in always-listen mode the robot only responds to voice commands that say its name.
Tap BICARA (on the screen or the big button in the web panel), then speak, for example "maju sedikit"
the robot records one sentence until you stop talking (at most 6 seconds), answers, moves, and sends the conversation to Telegram. The default, most economical way
Always listen: turn it on in the web panel or with /dengar on, then say "Zond, maju sedikit"
the robot listens all the time and responds to sentences that say its name. Wasteful: every sound in the room is sent to Groq. /dengar off to go back

The camera and microphone can record other people in the house. When always listen is on, every sentence it hears is sent to Groq to check whether it says the robot's name (at most 10 sentences per minute). Tell the people at home, and turn the robot off when not in use. By default always listen is off: the robot only listens after the BICARA button.
